@statsCommits.description: A column heading: the number of commits.

@statsShare.description: A column heading: a person's share of the commits.

@statsActive.description: A column heading: the days from a person's first commit to their last.

statsReadRepositories: Read {read} of {total, plural, one {# repository} other {# repositories}}
statsLibrarySummary: {commits, plural, one {commit} other {commits}} by {people, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} on {days, plural, one {# active day} other {# active days}} in {repos, plural, one {# repository} other {# repositories}}

@statsLibrarySummary.description: Follows the number of commits, shown large.

statsByWeekdayAndHour: By weekday and hour of the author's day
statsHeatTip: {day, date, ::EEEE} {from} to {to}: {count, plural, one {# commit} other {# commits}}

statsCalendarTip: {weekday, date, ::EEE} {day}: {count, plural, one {# commit} other {# commits}}

@statsCalendarTip.description: A day of the calendar, as Mon 2024-03-31: 3 commits.

@statsToDay.description: The day a streak ended, as to 2024-03-31.

@statsActiveDays.description: A column heading: the days with commits.

@statsPeople.description: A column heading: the number of people who committed.

@statsAge.description: A column heading: how long ago a repository's first commit was.

@statsSize.description: A column heading: a repository's size on disk.

statsReadingCommitsOf: Reading {read} of {total, plural, one {# commit} other {# commits}}

@managerTitle.description: The title of the dialog listing every known repository.

@managerOpen.description: A menu item: opens the repository.

@managerFetchInBackground.description: A menu item with a check mark.

@managerGroupCount.description: A group of repositories and how many it has.

@managerOpenGroup.description: Opens every repository of the group name.

@managerDeleteGroup.description: Deletes the group name; its repositories stay.

managerNoGroups: Open repositories to save them as a group.

@actionsError.description: A user's action that could not run, and why.

@actionsRun.description: A button: runs the user's action.

@actionsOpenFilesIn.description: A submenu of the editors a repository's files open in.

@actionsDefaultEditor.description: The editor used unless one is chosen; editor is its name.

@actionsBlame.description: A menu item: shows who last changed each line of the file, as git blame does.

@actionsActions.description: The log of the writes and the user's actions the app ran.

@actionsGitCommands.description: The log of every git command the app ran.

actionsEmpty: Commands the app runs here show up in this log
actionsLinesDropped: {count, plural, one {# earlier line not kept} other {# earlier lines not kept}}

@actionsDoneIn.description: A command that finished; duration is as 1.25s.

@cloneStop.description: A button: stops the clone running.

@cloneInto.description: The title of the folder picker for where to clone.

cloneNeedFolder: Choose a folder to clone into, or type its full path

@keysPalette.description: The list of every command, searched by typing.

@keysRefresh.description: A command: reads the repository again.

@keysUndo.description: A command: undoes the last change the app made.

@keysRedo.description: A command: redoes the last change undone.

@keysCommit.description: A command: commits the staged changes.

@keysPush.description: A command: pushes the current branch.

keysToggleStatusBar: Show or Hide the Status Bar

@keysUnknownModifier.description: A shortcut in the settings file the app cannot read; both are quoted as typed there.

@keysUnknownKey.description: A shortcut in the settings file the app cannot read; both are quoted as typed there.

@keysListLabel.description: A command in the list of shortcuts, and the shortcuts that run it.

@keysClear.description: A button: takes every shortcut off the command.

@keysReset.description: A button: gives the command its default shortcuts again.

@keysNoLongerRuns.description: A shortcut just taken from another command, as ⌘K no longer runs Command Palette.

@paletteOpenIn.description: Opens the repository in an editor or terminal; tool is its name, as Visual Studio Code or your editor.

@paletteGoTo.description: Shows the tab of an open repository.

@paletteOpenRecent.description: Opens a recent repository; path is its folder.

paletteStopFetching: Stop Fetching This Repository in the Background
paletteStartFetching: Fetch This Repository in the Background

@paletteUndo.description: what is the change undone, as Commit or Delete branch main.

@paletteRedo.description: what is the change redone, as Commit or Delete branch main.

@paletteLabel.description: The field of the command palette.

@issueLinksTitle.description: Rules that make issue references in commit messages, as PROJ-123, into links.

@issueLinksPattern.description: A regular expression an issue reference matches.

@issueLinksLink.description: The URL an issue reference links to.

@welcomeNew.description: A button: makes a new repository.

diagnosticsNote: Copy puts exactly this on the clipboard. Nothing is sent.

@diagnosticsIncludeCrash.description: file is the crash report's file name.

@diagnosticsOpenIssue.description: Opens the page where a user reports a problem with the app.

@askpassPassphrase.description: The passphrase of an SSH key.

@askpassPassphraseFor.description: The passphrase of an SSH key.

@askpassTrustHost.description: SSH asks whether to trust a server it has not met.

@askpassTrustHostNamed.description: SSH asks whether to trust a server it has not met.

@askpassSecurityKey.description: A hardware key, as a YubiKey, that SSH waits for.

@tabsClose.description: The button that closes a repository's tab.

@gitLogRowLabel.description: A git command in the log, and how it ended.

gitLogBytesDropped: {count, plural, one {# more byte not kept} other {# more bytes not kept}}

@gitLogStarted.description: A git command that runs in the background.

@gitLogStopped.description: A git command the app stopped.

@gitLogExit.description: A git command that ended with an exit code.

@appYourEditor.description: The editor the settings name, as in Open in your editor.

@appYourTerminal.description: The terminal the settings name, as in Open in your terminal.

appGitOutdated: Git {version} lacks security fixes: update git

@appOpenRepository.description: The title of the folder picker.

@appNewRepository.description: The title of the folder picker.

appShellNotRead: Your login shell's settings were not read, so git runs with the app's own PATH: {error}

@appShellNotRead.description: PATH is the environment variable; keep it as is.

@menuRefresh.description: A menu item: reads the repository again.

@windowCompare.description: The title of the window git opens as its difftool.

@windowMerge.description: The title of the window git opens as its mergetool.

sessionFetchInBackground: Fetch all remotes in the background

@sessionFetchInBackground.description: An entry of the command log.

@sessionTurnOnMonitor.description: An entry of the command log: turns on git's file system monitor.

@sessionWriteCommitGraph.description: An entry of the command log; commit-graph is git's file.

@sessionSnapshotNow.description: Why a snapshot of the work tree was taken; kept with the snapshot.

@sessionSnapshotNowIgnored.description: Why a snapshot of the work tree was taken; kept with the snapshot.

@sessionRestoreSnapshot.description: An entry of the command log; time is when the snapshot was taken, as 2024-03-31 09:15:00.

@sessionUndo.description: An entry of the command log; what is the change undone.

@sessionRedo.description: An entry of the command log; what is the change redone.

sessionNoDiffTool: no diff tool is set: set diff.tool or diff.guitool in git's config

sessionTooManyDiffTools: too many diff tools are open

sessionNotFirstParent: this commit is not on HEAD's line of first parents

@sessionNoCommitNamed.description: name is what was asked for, quoted.
